scripts.start:test: NODE_ENV=test sh -c "${COVERAGE_APP_CMD:?Set COVERAGE_APP_CMD to the command that serves the Istanbul-instrumented build of the app under test}"
scripts.test:coverage:low: COVERAGE=true TESTDINO_TAGS=coverage,low npx tdpw test --coverage --project=coverage --ci-run-id coverage-low --grep @coverage-low
scripts.test:coverage:mid: COVERAGE=true TESTDINO_TAGS=coverage,mid npx tdpw test --coverage --project=coverage --ci-run-id coverage-mid --grep @coverage-mid
scripts.test:coverage:high: COVERAGE=true TESTDINO_TAGS=coverage,high npx tdpw test --coverage --project=coverage --ci-run-id coverage-high --grep @coverage-high
scripts.orchestrate:discover: node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/.bin/tdpw orchestrate discover --project chromium --out orchestration.mint.json
